newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's treasury to sell Banco di Napoli stake.
newsitem.headline: Italy's treasury to sell Banco di Napoli stake.

text.p: Italy's Treasury said in a statement on Monday it intended to sell its 60 percent ordinary share capital stake in Banco di Napoli.
It said Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi had signed a decree enabling the Treasury to sell its holding.

The statement said the sale would take place in several stages, with bidders required to declare an interest by November 18. Those accepted by the Treasury would then have until December 20 to present their formal bids.
The sale would be decided by highest bidder, providing the price was deemed acceptable to the Treasury and that the bidder had obtained the Bank of Italy's necessary authorisation.
The statement said that the Treasury would also subscribe to a capital increase for the bank agreed last July. It added that Rothschild Italia SpA would advise on the sale.
